selection.typical: Near median of image-level median replacement counts; no outcome-based ranking.
selection.helpful: C correct, U wrong on the same task at seed 2041; geometric-margin improvement >=0.005. Rank by repair and positive-margin consistency across three existing seeds.
selection.boundary: Replacement count at least pair-level Q75; no primary accuracy improvement on either task and nonpositive C-U margin gain averaged across tasks/seeds. Prioritize repeatable harm, then change count near Q75.
selection.role: Purposefully selected qualitative examples, not aggregate performance estimates.

crop_preprocessing: Server existing CLIP _transform(224) first three operations: bicubic shorter-side Resize224, CenterCrop224, RGB. Applied after original.convert(RGB), before normalization.
